title: 野蛮人之王

sync.scope: Source statistics tables and available 2026 history; base values

history.description: Moved the Barbarian King from Town Hall 7 to Town Hall 4. Added special mechanics for level 1, where his health and damage are scaled, at 50% at Town Hall 4, 75% at Town Hall 5, and 100% at Town Hall 6. He cannot defend the village and can only be used by attacking during these aforementioned Town Hall levels until his Hero Banner is first placed, where he can then be upgraded starting at Town Hall 7.

facts: The Barbarian King is the first Hero unlocked in the Home Village at Town Hall level 4 when players finish the construction of the Hero Hall. He is a larger and stronger version of the Barbarian.
When the Blacksmith is constructed and is upgraded to level 3, it unlocks the Earthquake Boots and Vampstache respectively.
